    1 module AtomSimulator.Units where
    2 import Data.Metrology
    3 import Data.Metrology.TH
    4 import Data.Metrology.Show ()
    5 import Data.Array.IArray
    6 
    7 -- ===REGION Base Units
    8 declareMonoUnit "Nanometer" (Just "nm")
    9 -- | Length is a physical dimension that quantifies the space between points
   10 type Length = MkQu_D Nanometer
   11 declareDerivedUnit "MicroMeter" [t| Nanometer |] 1e3 (Just "um")
   12 declareDerivedUnit "Meter" [t| Nanometer |] 1e9 (Just "m")
   13 declareDerivedUnit "Bohr" [t| Nanometer |] 0.0529177249 (Just "m")
   14 declareDerivedUnit "InverseCubicNanometer" [t| Number :/ Nanometer :/ Nanometer :/ Nanometer |] 1 (Just "nm^-3")
   15 
   16 declareMonoUnit "ElectronVolt" (Just "eV")
   17 {-| Energy is a conserved property in physical systems. Particles can have different potential energies at
   18 different points in space and the energy that a particle in a system have can be quantized.-}
   19 type Energy = MkQu_D ElectronVolt
   20 declareDerivedUnit "Joule" [t| ElectronVolt |] 6.241509074e18 (Just "J")
   21 declareDerivedUnit "MegaElectronVolt" [t| ElectronVolt |] 1e6 (Just "MeV")
   22 declareDerivedUnit "Hartree" [t| ElectronVolt |] 27.2114 (Just "E h")
   23 
   24 declareMonoUnit "AtomicUnit" (Just "Au")
   25 -- | Mass is a property of particles that decreases the wavelength of particles
   26 type Mass = MkQu_D AtomicUnit
   27 declareDerivedUnit "Kilogram" [t| AtomicUnit |] 6.02214076e26 (Just "kg")
   28 
   29 declareMonoUnit "ElementaryCharge" (Just "e")
   30 -- | Charge is a property of particles that attracts particles with opposite sign charge and repels ones with same sign charge
   31 type Charge = MkQu_D ElementaryCharge
   32 
   33 -- | Spin is an intrinsic form of angular momentum carried by particles. There are 2 orthogonal states of spin for spin 1/2 spin particles
   34 data Spin = SpinUp | SpinDown deriving (Eq, Show)
   35 
   36 -- | Turns spin up to spin down and vice versa
   37 flipSpin :: Maybe Spin -> Maybe Spin
   38 flipSpin Nothing = Nothing

   39 flipSpin (Just SpinUp) = Just SpinDown

   40 flipSpin (Just SpinDown) = Just SpinUp
   41 -- ===ENDREGION
   42 
   43 -- ===REGION Derived Unit Types
   44 -- | Density is the amount of something in a given volume of 3D space.
   45 type Density  = Length %^ MThree
   46 {-| Speed Squared is an abstract concept that represents the amount of distance covered by an object in a certain
   47 amount of time... squared -}
   48 type SpeedSq = MkQu_D (ElectronVolt :/ AtomicUnit)
   49 -- | Measure of electric polarizability of a dielectric material
   50 type Permittivity = MkQu_D (ElementaryCharge :* ElementaryCharge :/ ElectronVolt :/ Nanometer)
   51 -- | Energy times distance
   52 type EnergyDist = MkQu_D (ElectronVolt :* Nanometer)
   53 -- | Energy times time, squared
   54 type EnergyTimeSq = MkQu_D (ElectronVolt :* Nanometer :* Nanometer :* AtomicUnit)
   55 -- | Length to negative one power
   56 type InverseLength = Length %^ MOne
   57 -- | Length to the negative two power
   58 type InverseLengthSq = Length %^ MTwo
   59 -- | This is a constant for the slope of a force that scales linearly with distance. Like the force on a spring
   60 type SpringConstant = MkQu_D (ElectronVolt :/ Nanometer :/ Nanometer)
   61 -- | A distance times a distances, or an area
   62 type DistSq = MkQu_D (Nanometer :* Nanometer)
   63 -- ===ENDREGION
   64 
   65 -- ===REGION Physical Constants
   66 -- | Light travels a constant amount of distance in a given amount of time
   67 lightSpeedSq :: SpeedSq
   68 lightSpeedSq = (2.99792458*10^8)^2 |*| (1 % Joule) |/| (1 % Kilogram)
   69 
   70 -- | This is the mass of an electron particle at rest. 
   71 electronMass :: Mass
   72 electronMass = (0.510998 % MegaElectronVolt) |/| lightSpeedSq
   73 -- | This is the mass of a proton particle at rest. 
   74 protonMass :: Mass
   75 protonMass = (938.272 % MegaElectronVolt) |/| lightSpeedSq
   76 -- | Permittivity of free space
   77 vacuumPermittivity :: Permittivity
   78 vacuumPermittivity = (55.26349406 % ElementaryCharge) |*| (1 % ElementaryCharge) |/| (1 % ElectronVolt) |/| (1 % MicroMeter)
   79 -- ===ENDREGION
   80 
   81 -- | The charge of an electron
   82 electronCharge :: Charge
   83 electronCharge = (-1) % ElementaryCharge
   84 -- | The charge of a proton
   85 protonCharge :: Charge
   86 protonCharge = 1 % ElementaryCharge
   87 
   88 {-| An array represnting a 3D space. Each point contains a 3D coordinate identifier for its corresponding space on
   89 the grid and a value contained at that point -} 
   90 type Grid3D a = Array (Int,Int,Int) a
   91 
   92 {-| A grid representing physical space. Contains a length saying the spacing between each item in the grid.
   93 Also contains a 3d grid/triple array containing all of the points in the grid with arbitrary units.-}
   94 data PhysicalGrid a = PhysicalGrid { spacing :: Length, samples :: Grid3D a } deriving (Show, Eq)
   95 
   96 -- | Planck's constant (h) times speed of light
   97 hc :: EnergyDist  
   98 hc = 1239.841984 % (ElectronVolt :* Nanometer)
   99 
  100 -- | Plank constant squared
  101 h2 :: EnergyTimeSq
  102 h2 = hc |*| hc |/| lightSpeedSq
  103 
  104 -- | Plank constant squared
  105 hbar2 :: EnergyTimeSq
  106 hbar2 = h2 |/| (2 * pi)^2
